category_edits.rationale: Test a smaller causal pooled-state contribution across all four datasets: 85% current GRU state and 15% pooled state, retaining the three-interaction half-life. Prior evidence records regression for this configuration; this implements the supplied hypothesis without claiming improvement. Preserve causal masking, final-real-position inference and all other model and training settings.

response.change_summary: Reduce causal pooling weight from 0.20 to 0.15 and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor. Retain one GRU4Rec checkpoint per dataset.
